name: Chattogram Metropolitan Police — thanas and official numbers
notes: No licence stated. Only institutional numbers are collected: OC and duty-officer police official mobiles (01320-05xxxx) from the cmp.gov.bd contact directory, the Commissioner post's official mobile, the HQ office phone and pccmp@police.gov.bd, and the control-room numbers.
